originals.why: Moved from 'be’ ddudodd o'. Natural North Welsh, and 'ddudodd o' still means 'he said', as this course taught it.

originals.ko: 그녀가 말하고 있던 것과 그가 말한 것
originals.why: Natural Welsh. 'ddudodd o' keeps the sense 'he said'.

originals.ko: 너 나에게 그가 말한 것을 말해 줄 수 있어?
originals.why: Idiomatic Welsh. The LEGO is used in the sense this course taught.

originals.ko: 내가 그가 말한 것을 알아낼 수만 있다면
originals.why: Natural 'taswn i ond yn medru'. 'ddudodd o' means 'he said', as taught.

originals.ko: 미안해, 하지만 그것은 그가 말한 것이 아니야
originals.why: Natural Welsh. 'ddudodd o' keeps the sense 'he said'.

originals.ko: 나는 그가 말한 것을 논의하고 싶지 않아
originals.why: Natural Welsh. 'ddudodd o' keeps the sense 'he said'.

originals.ko: 그는 그녀가 조금 더 천천히 이야기하려고 노력하는 게 낫겠다고 말했어
originals.why: 'ddudodd o y byddai’n well iddi hi…' is idiomatic. It is the exact 'he said that…' frame this LEGO teaches.

originals.ko: 그는 어젯밤에 다른 거 뭐라도 말했어?
originals.why: A natural North Welsh past-tense question. 'unrhyw beth arall' fits in a question.
